# Generate a 4-regular circulant graph on 12 vertices
# Each vertex i is connected to (i+1)%12, (i-1)%12, (i+2)%12, (i-2)%12

edges = set()
n = 12
for i in range(n):
    for offset in [1, 2]:
        j = (i + offset) % n
        u, v = min(i, j), max(i, j)
        edges.add((u, v))

edges = sorted(list(edges))

# Verify degrees
degrees = [0] * n
for u, v in edges:
    degrees[u] += 1
    degrees[v] += 1

print("Edges:", edges)
print("Degrees:", degrees)
print("All degrees between 3 and 6:", all(3 <= d <= 6 for d in degrees))
print("Number of edges:", len(edges))
